# Memory index

## Work

- [[hub-acme-storefront]] — Acme Storefront: e-commerce rebuild, weekly demo on Fridays, launch planned end of quarter
- [[hub-acme-booking]] — Acme Booking: appointment scheduling service, calendar sync, reminders by SMS
- [[hub-acme-design-system]] — Acme design system: tokens, components, dark mode, shared across both apps
- [[person-colleague-nora]] — Nora: backend engineer the team pairs with on the booking service
- [[person-colleague-ravi]] — Ravi: contractor, prefers written specs over calls, works async
- [[work-standup-notes]] — Standing notes for the weekly sync: agenda, decisions, open questions
- [[work-oncall-rotation]] — On-call rotation: schedule, escalation path, handoff checklist
- [[work-review-checklist]] — Code review checklist: tests, rollback plan, feature flags
- [[work-meeting-notes-archive]] — Older meeting notes, kept for reference only
- [[work-hiring-notes]] — Hiring notes: open roles, interview loop, feedback collected so far

## Family

- [[hub-household-planning]] — Household planning: budget, chores rotation, shared calendar
- [[person-partner]] — Partner: schedule overlaps, shared errands, weekend plans
- [[person-child-one]] — Older child: school schedule, activities, upcoming appointments
- [[person-child-two]] — Younger child: daycare schedule, allergy notes, pediatrician contact
- [[family-trip-planning]] — Ongoing trip planning: destinations shortlisted, budget range, dates considered
- [[family-birthdays]] — Birthdays and anniversaries: dates, gift ideas, past gifts given
- [[family-school-contacts]] — School contacts: teachers, office hours, parent portal login hint (no password)
- [[family-pet-care]] — Pet care: feeding schedule, vet contact, next check-up date

## Home

- [[hub-home-lab]] — Home lab: a small NAS running backups, a media server and a self-hosted memory viewer
- [[home-network-layout]] — Network layout: VLANs, router model, Wi-Fi access points and their locations
- [[home-smart-devices]] — Smart home devices: lights and heating automations, presence detection
- [[home-backup-routine]] — Backup routine: nightly snapshots, weekly off-site copy, monthly restore test
- [[home-maintenance-log]] — Maintenance log: filters changed, appliances serviced, warranty dates
- [[home-renovation-plans]] — Renovation plans: kitchen shortlist, contractor quotes compared
- [[home-utility-accounts]] — Utility accounts: providers and account numbers (no passwords stored here)
- [[home-insurance-notes]] — Insurance notes: policy renewal dates, what is and is not covered
- [[home-garden-notes]] — Garden notes: what is planted, watering schedule, seasonal tasks

## Tech

- [[hub-reference-ops]] — Operations reference: shared playbooks for the home lab and client staging servers
- [[knowledge-docker-pitfalls]] — Docker pitfalls met over time: file permissions, DNS, bind mounts
- [[knowledge-reverse-proxy]] — Reverse proxy setup: TLS, headers for server-sent events, timeouts
- [[knowledge-mqtt]] — MQTT basics for home automation: topics, retained messages, QoS

- [[knowledge-css-tokens]] — CSS design tokens: naming, light/dark themes, contrast checks
- [[reference-dev-environment]] — Dev environment: editor setup, shell aliases, Node version manager
- [[reference-git-workflow]] — Git workflow: small commits, rebase before merge, conventional messages
- [[reference-incident-log]] — Incident log: symptom, cause and fix of every incident since tracking began
- [[knowledge-backup-strategy]] — Backup strategy notes: retention windows, restore test cadence
